sources: week2_attack_v7_pristine60/run_clean_screen.py sets WRONG = 0.5 and eligible requires output_valid plus ANLS >= 0.5
week2_attack_v4_answer_aligned/loss.py output_valid is nonempty stripped text
week2_attack_v7d DEV_MANIFEST_COPY clean_full_pred is the frozen Full generate string
full_baseline: decoded Full generate text must equal the frozen clean_full_pred. A mismatch is FAIL_FULL_BASELINE_REPLAY.
clean_correctness: ANLS >= 0.5 against the manifest answers. The numeric threshold is the frozen WRONG = 0.5.
not_executed: The clean screen also requires FastV ANLS, FastV K, and the FastV hook hash. Those clauses are not run and are not replaced by a new threshold.
replay: Reload the same PNG pages from disk and require the same token ids, the same text, and the same source-index hash.
